# Internal export-input snapshot handoff

Source: `f06be467856db3ef0f48a683d01a1d3e620701b3`, signed G, direct child of actual main `6eb9a2c12bda2e31fe3006a955b24302adddbfe5`.
Tree: `/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/project-macros/sandbox-crypto`, branch `impl/document-export-inputs`; prior macro ref preserved. Six declared paths only, no central tracking edits.

API: `documents.exports.ExportInputs(documents, projects).prepare(project, request, trusted_author)` and `.get(project, snapshot_id)`. Current/current selection shares one read snapshot; numbered history uses saved macro pins. Parsing/reconstruction runs outside transactions; atomic append rechecks exact-operation replay and actual retained byte/count quotas. Original source/parser/map/TeX/effective macros/scope pins remain immutable. Canonical reconstruction refuses self-consistent forged derived payloads.

Logical budgets: source 1 MiB, saved map read 4 MiB, parser 4 KiB, payload 4 MiB, 20,000 spans; project 256/64 MiB and global 1,024/256 MiB. USER identity 128 UTF-8 bytes. No eviction. Overlarge maps, unknown historical context, unsupported profiles/resources and deleted source produce explicit held pins where representable. Snapshot/quota refusal does not veto ordinary saves.

Validation logs:
- `/tmp/document-export-inputs-affected.log`: 134 affected tests, including 53 export cases; command `uv run pytest -q packages/orchestrator/tests/test_document_exports.py packages/orchestrator/tests/test_document_store.py packages/orchestrator/tests/test_project_macros.py packages/orchestrator/tests/test_document_editing.py`.
- `/tmp/document-export-inputs-static.log`: `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run pyright`, `uv run python scripts/check_licenses.py`, `uv run python scripts/generate_protos.py --check`, `git diff --check`; exit 0. 455 formatted files, strict 0 errors/warnings, 75 distributions licensed.
- `/tmp/document-export-inputs-profile-fixture.log`: typed tuple-only saved-profile fixture follow-up, 1 passed.

Independent review closed canonical derived-projection forgery and TeX control-word digit-boundary cases. Reviewer cleared exact signed source f06be467 with no remaining actionable source/docs issue.

Proposed root tracking text: internal bounded export-input prerequisite implemented locally with trusted USER/ordinary agent scope, exact immutable Markdown/parser/TeX/macro pins, durable replay and explicit unsupported holds. LD-35–38 conversion/staging/execution/export lineage and complete .tex/PDF delivery remain open. No route/UI/converter/worker/model/service/runtime acceptance or full suite was run in the author slice; root owns combined delivery gates and integration.

   after the read/write transaction closes. Disposable state was removed.

   prepare probes for input0, openin1 and write18 formerly returned prepared;
   the corrected code returns held/unsupported_resources. ASCII-letter control
   termination and dynamic ^^ syntax are covered in source and macro tests.

- Trusted USER or ordinary MAIN/delegated attribution and project/session
  membership; no worker/platform/reviewer authority or public export route.

  identities and macro pins; unknown or unsupported proof remains explicitly held.

  UTF-8 requester bound, canonical receipt replay and actual retained-column byte
  plus count quotas; snapshot and receipt append atomically without eviction.
- Resource detection is a limited conservative dependency gate, not a TeX safety
  certificate. No conversion, staging, resource resolution or execution enabled.
- Author logs inspected: 134 affected cases (53 exports) passed in 2.13 seconds;
